known_gap: Human comprehension/preference at extreme WPM remains unclaimed. ORP/chunking choices should now be driven by actual reading use, not by adding more geometry.
capability: Read one local source through one canonical position while scale, ORP focus, linear source strip, RSVP time, speech-boundary time, highlighted context and XREF change around it. Geometry remains an optional host projection rather than the public reading surface.

experimental_projection.mapping: ring geometry retained inside field-aperture.js for hosts that earn it; READFIELD default is linear
experimental_projection.claim: Position witness only; never semantic importance and no longer a prerequisite for use.

return_contract.law: READFIELD/APERTURE emits addressed focus state; source bytes and canonical truth remain outside the projection.
